idea-plugin.name: Quick Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Quick Notes keeps your thoughts where your code lives. Capture ideas, TODOs, snippets, and meeting notes in a distraction-free notepad docked right inside your IDE — no context switching, no lost sticky notes.

Every note is written on a warm, ruled legal-pad editor and saved automatically, so your work is always there when you come back — across restarts and across every project.

Why you'll love it

  • 📝 Auto-save that just works — type freely; notes persist globally across IDE sessions.
  • 🗂️ Everything in one place — a clean, searchable, sortable list with a single-click editor.
  • 🎨 Make it yours — custom titles and per-note background colors from a handy palette.
  • 📌 Stay organized — pin important notes to the top and star your favorites.
  • ⚡ Keyboard-first — create, delete, search, and jump between notes with shortcuts.
  • 🧭 Fast navigation — flip through notes with previous/next controls.
  • 🗑️ Safe deletes — pick exactly which notes to remove, or clear all, always with confirmation.
  • 🔁 Own your data — import and export as JSON or Markdown with smart conflict handling.
  • 🌗 Looks right anywhere — automatic light and dark theme support.

Lightweight & dependency-free — a tiny plugin with zero bundled third-party libraries, so it stays fast and out of your way.

Works in all IntelliJ-based IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, CLion, and more.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — Initial release 🎉

  • 📝 Ruled legal-pad note editor with automatic saving and global persistence.
  • 🗂️ Searchable, sortable notes list with a single-click, single-window editor.
  • 🎨 Custom note titles and per-note background colors.
  • 📌 Pin notes to the top and ⭐ mark favorites.
  • ⚡ Keyboard shortcuts plus previous/next navigation.
  • 🗑️ Selective and bulk delete, always with confirmation.
  • 🔁 JSON & Markdown import/export with conflict handling.
  • 🌗 Light and dark theme support.
